availability.note: Deepal AU has no Build & Price configurator; the official S07 page and offer page (2026-11-26) advertise 'with 20-inch wheels from $47,990 driveaway', 'Available for delivery now. While stocks last.', no end date. Run-out: 19-inch version sold out and remaining stock is 2025-built (CarExpert 7 Jul 2026). Melbourne retailers: Deepal Melbourne City, Deepal Doncaster. Single grade.

listPrice.note: Deepal AU offer $47,990 drive-away (20-inch wheels, excl. premium paint, private buyers, while stocks last, no end date). (47990 - 958.80)/1.042 = 45,136.1; round-trip through calc/onroad.js driveAwayPrice: 47,989.86 (stamp duty 1,898.86 + rego 880). Flat national figure that bundles recommended dealer delivery and CTP, so the back-out overstates the true list by an estimated $1,000-2,500. No independent verification available: Deepal publishes no list price or on-road estimate (only the 20-inch option at $1,100 'excluding government and statutory charges'). Launch list was $53,900 before on-road costs (CarExpert review); CarsGuide's $49,990 'MSRP' matches the mid-2025 $49,990 drive-away campaign and is not used. Manufacturer's published price used per owner decision. Re-derived 2026-11-27 for VIC rego $958.80 (was 45,211 at $880; round trip 47990.51).

batteryKwh.note: usable 78.0 kWh, nominal 80.0 kWh (EV Database, European S07, 20-inch). Deepal AU spec sheet quotes 79.97 kWh unlabelled, i.e. gross; same 79.97 kWh ternary pack and 160 kW RWD as Europe (changaneurope.com spec).

rangeKm.note: Deepal AU spec sheet v2.2: 'Estimated WLTP Driving Range 475 km' (ADR 81/02 footnote). Europe sells only the 20-inch 255/45R20 version and rates it 475 km WLTP (EV Database TEL; changaneurope.com), the same wheel as the only orderable AU car; AU figure equals, not exceeds, WLTP so passes the direction test.

consumptionKwhPer100km.note: Deepal AU spec sheet 'WLTP Energy Consumption 18.6 kWh/100km'; ~13% above usable/range (16.4), consistent with a grid-to-wheel figure including charging losses (EV Database WLTP vehicle consumption 16.4 kWh/100km); same treatment as xpeng-g6.

bootLitresSeatsUp.note: AU spec sheet 'Trunk 445' L, frunk 125 L excluded; CarExpert review same. Measurement method not stated (EV Database lists 510 L, likely including underfloor); to-cover convention assumed for the AU figure.

bootLitresSeatsDown.note: AU spec sheet 'Trunk with Seat Folded Down 1385' L; method not stated, may be to the roof.

towKg.note: AU spec sheet maximum braked towing 1500 kg (unbraked 750)

warrantyYears.note: '7-year/160,000 kilometre new car warranty', no servicing condition stated; battery 8 yr/240,000 km

insuranceAnnual.note: down from held 2,200 as the effective list fell ~$8.7k; above mazda-cx-6e-gt 1,900 ($53,990, same platform, mainstream network) for a small new brand with thin repair network; xpeng-g6-long-range 1,900, byd-sealion-7-premium 1,650.

depreciationCurve.note: deviates from mainstream on documented evidence: run-out of 2025-built stock at $47,990 d/a vs $53,900 launch list (CarExpert 7 Jul 2026), repeated drive-away campaigns since mid-2025, thin local volume, new brand, update teased. Softened from held [1,0.68,0.56,0.47,0.40,0.34] to match zeekr-7x (new Chinese brand, same evidence class) for consistency.
